title: Demoness by the Lake
description: A black silhouette of a horned female demon with glowing red eyes sits on a rock in dark water, holding a flowering branch. The surreal scene features floating crystal pillars, glowing orbs containing figures, koi fish, lotus flowers, pink clouds, and multiple blue eyes in a cracked night sky with a pink sunset horizon.
prompt: A surreal fantasy scene at dusk over a calm lake, a black silhouette of a horned female demon with glowing red eyes sits on a rock in the water holding a branch with yellow blossoms, multiple glowing blue orbs float in the water containing miniature figures, green crystal pillars rise from the lake, pink clouds and lotus flowers, koi fish swimming, multiple blue eyes watching from a cracked dark sky, reflective water surface, mystical and symbolic atmosphere
